subject: Your ZAGROS access now includes the relay-health dashboard
headline: The relay-health dashboard is now open to every active ZAGROS participant — including you.
what: It shows, from an outside vantage, the health of the goatnet's network — the relays and the host nodes: up/down, latency, and a plain “is it me or the network?” verdict. Federation-health checks are coming next.
howto: Open it and sign in with the same account you already use — no new password.
why: The relays and host nodes are the connective tissue of the goatnet: traffic rides the relays when the mesh can't find a direct path, and the nodes carry the services. If something feels slow or unreachable, this tells you in seconds whether it's your link or the fabric — and soon it will confirm cross-site federation is healthy too.
why_admin: As an administrator you also see the gated per-relay detail beneath the public reachability verdict.
